messages:
mira: quick heads-up, onboarding a compact embed 'ripple-emb' (dim=640) on staging. initial int6_pc run on semsim-5k shows recall@1 drop vs roberta-768.
sam: paste numbers + cmd pls.
mira: cmd: ./bin/eval_embeddings --model ripple-emb --quant int6_pc --holdout semsim-5k --norm l2
summary: baseline recall@1=0.70, ripple int6_pc recall@1=0.61; avg_top1_shift=0.18
liam: big top1 shift. run fp16 same checkpoint to isolate quant error.
bench-bot: fp16 job finished -> recall@1=0.69, fp16 close to baseline.
sam: quant looks to blame. try int6_sym, int8_pc, and a larger calib (10k).
mira: queued int6_sym, int8_pc, calib10k. will capture per-dim clipping heatmap and neighbor-shift.
(8m)
mira: results: int6_sym recall@1=0.66 avg_shift=0.11; int8_pc recall@1=0.69 avg_shift=0.04; int6_pc+calib10k recall@1=0.64 avg_shift=0.10
sam: pattern clear. plan: default int8_pc for rollout; keep int6 as opt-in with calibration + extra holdouts and neighbor-shift threshold in CI. mira, open PR with calibration hook and export metrics.
mira: will do. attaching s3 artifacts in PR.
